PREDICTED CLASS AREAS

Interpretation boundaries

What is demonstrated: twelve-month inference outputs, scene receipts, observation coverage, area accounting and transparent qualitative warning rules across urban and arid examples. What is not demonstrated: independently verified 2026 land cover, validated change events, calibrated uncertainty, reliable detection of individual roads or buildings, or strong out-of-domain generalization.

Trained model: frozen FP32 ResNet34 U-Net temporal checkpoint, trained with 2021 Sentinel-1 observations and Dynamic World weak labels. Test mIoU 42.39% and OA 74.17% measure agreement with weak reference labels. Year-matched truth is not included for these sites. Quality rules: review if ≤2 scenes, mapped coverage under 95%, predicted class ≥90%, or consecutive predicted class change ≥5 percentage points. These thresholds are review heuristics, not significance testing.

Offline report generated from saved exports. Source acquisition receipts and unmodified raster files remain in the accompanying case ZIPs. Analysis is retrospective, not a live feed.
